expert.name: Elsa
expert.quote: Swedish Lapland is the aurora trip for people who want the wild version: huskies, ice and very few other travellers.
expert.tip: Abisko sits in a rain shadow and has the clearest skies in the Nordics. If you only have one night to chase the lights, make it that one.

summary: A week in Swedish Lapland built round the aurora: huskies and dinner on the frozen sea at Brändön, a northern lights safari, Camp Ripan in Kiruna, a night in Abisko and a final night in the Icehotel.
